creative.central_question: The one question the viewer wants answered by the end.
creative.payoff: The concrete takeaway delivered in the payoff beat.
creative.visual_motif: One recurring visual element that carries the idea (e.g. a request packet travelling through the system).
creative.music: low-energy synth bed, ducked under voice, no lyrics (licence recorded in manifest)

scenes.narration: Opening question or surprising concrete claim.
scenes.motion: hook words punch in one by one on voice stress, slow 3% push-in
scenes.visual_description: Single focal object of the motif on dark background, hook text above it.

scenes.narration: Why this matters to the viewer, stated in one sentence.
scenes.motion: motif object moves into a simple 3-node diagram; nodes draw on in narration order
scenes.visual_description: Three labelled nodes, one highlighted in accent colour.

scenes.narration: The mechanism, one step at a time.
scenes.motion: camera pans along the flow; a packet travels each arrow as it is named; callout labels pop at each hop
scenes.visual_description: Left-to-right flow wrapped into a vertical S-curve for 9:16.

scenes.narration: A concrete example with a real, sourced number or behaviour.
scenes.motion: bars grow from zero in 0.6 s, value label counts up, source line fades in last
scenes.visual_description: Two-bar comparison, labelled units, source and date under the chart.

scenes.narration: The takeaway the viewer can act on.
scenes.motion: motif returns from scene 1, now resolved; foreground and background layers drift at different speeds
scenes.visual_description: Callback to the hook image showing the answer.
scenes.visual_justification: Depth separates the 'before' and 'after' layers of the same motif.

scenes.narration: One focused question for the comments.
scenes.motion: question text types on; channel motif loops subtly so the last frame can loop to the first
scenes.visual_description: Clean end card with the question; loopable into scene 1.
